latvia.title: Bird influenza detected on Staicele farm
latvia.description: An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 has been detected on a farm in Staicele, Limbaži region, with approximately 30 different species of poultry, according to laboratory tests conducted at the Scientific Institute of Food Safety, Animal Health and Environment (BIOR).

latvia.title: Introduction of EU 'Temu tax' had an immediate effect in Latvia
latvia.description: The introduction of a new tax on parcels arriving in Latvia from third countries has greatly reduced their number, fresh data shows.

latvia.title: Kulbergs plans to axe Climate and Energy Ministry, ponders special portfolios
latvia.description: Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) signalled on Monday that he intends to shake up the shape of government, cutting at least one ministry and potentially inviting people from outside politics to take charge at other ministries.

latvia.title: First American volunteer enjoying his Latvian military service
latvia.description: "Washington" – that's the nickname given to the State Defence Service (VAD) soldier Kārlis, who has been serving in Kurzeme, in the 4th Brigade of the National Guard, for several months now. Kārlis is the first State Defense Service soldier from the United States.

latvia.title: Estonian security chief: 'I hope Latvia will take sufficient measures'
latvia.description: Estonian public media ERR News has an interesting interview with the country's security service chief concerning a recent incident in which eight Latvian nationals were arrested on suspicion of a Russia-backed sabotage plot.

latvia.title: Blood sugar check campaign shows worrying trend in Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 13 November, during the Diabetes Screening Day held at Riga 1st Hospital, more than half of those who attended had blood sugar levels above the normal range, the hospital reported.

latvia.title: Latvia's Nations League campaign closes with a draw
latvia.description: Latvia's UEFA Nations League campaign for 2026 has reached a merciful conclusion, finishing with a match at home against Armenia on Sunday, November 15th.

latvia.title: Eight puppies born at Latvian Border Guard College
latvia.description: On 10 November, eight Belgian Shepherd puppies – five females and three males – were born at the Cynology Centre of the State Border Guard College’s Cynology Service. The puppies’ mother is Josie from the State Border Guard Service, the college reported.

latvia.title: Gloomy November week ahead in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that rainfall is likely to be frequent in Latvia this week.

latvia.title: Rīga loses million euro street light project
latvia.description: Riga has lost the opportunity to use more than 740,000 euros in state funding to replace street lights. According to the Latvian Television programme “De facto” aired on November 15, the local authority selected “Vizulo Solutions” as the tender winner twice, but the Public Procurement Monitoring Bureau overturned both decisions after competitors filed complaints.

latvia.title: United List, National Alliance agree on government formation
latvia.description: The current Prime Minister, Andris Kulbergs (United List), who has been entrusted by the President with forming a new government, has announced that the United List (AS) and the National Alliance (NA) have agreed to cooperate in forming the new government, Latvian Television reported Sunday evening.

latvia.title: Icy roads in parts of Latvia Monday morning
latvia.description: On Monday, November 16, ice on the roads of Latvia creates difficult driving conditions in Vidzeme, Latgale, and around Talsi, said Latvian State Roads (LVC).

latvia.description: Eight Latvian nationals have been detained after an attempt to commit arson at Estonian drone manufacturer Threod Systems, reports Estonian public media ERR.

latvia.description: Can Latvia record a win during this Nations League campaign? Can they finish the group with more than one point? The country's top footballers have one final chance of answering these questions in the affirmative on Sunday with the final group game against Armenia in Rīga.

latvia.description: The Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on November 13th that, in cooperation with other competent ministries, it has prepared a draft Cabinet regulation proposing a ban on the transit of grain originating in Russia and Belarus through the territory of Latvia.

latvia.title: 'We have to grow some bigger balls' recommends Latvian Prime Minister
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) did not mince his words at the informal meeting of the heads of state or government of the European Union (EU) in Dublin, Ireland, on November 13th, recommending a testosterone-filled course of action for the continent.

latvia.title: Latvia slashed its greenhouse gas emissions in Q2
latvia.description: New Eurostat data shows that in the second quarter of 2026 Latvia managed to cut its greenhouse gas emissions by an impressive amount.

latvia.title: Regional public transport ticket prices will increase by around 10% next year
latvia.description: The Public Transport Council on Friday supported an increase in fares on regional bus and train routes by an average of 10% in 2027, according to information provided by the Road Transport Directorate (ATD).

latvia.title: New Virši fueling station opens in Rīga
latvia.description: The energy trader AS ‘Virši-A’, which operates under the ‘Virši’ brand, has invested 2.2 million euros in the construction of a new full-service petrol station on Vienības gatve in Riga, the company announced on November 13.

latvia.title: Latvia's employment figures at 66% in third quarter
latvia.description: Results from the Labour Force Survey (LFS) conducted by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) show that in Latvia 897.0 thousand people, or 66.1 % of the population 1 aged 15–74, were employed in Q3 2026. Year on year, the employment rate rose only slightly overall, with increase also recorded among young people. Unemployment rate stood at 6.7 %.

latvia.title: Coalition talks nearing some result in Latvia
latvia.description: The formation of the government is nearing completion – the United List still needs to reach agreement with the National Alliance on certain issues, as stated by Māris Kučinskis, chair of the United List parliamentary group, following a meeting with President Edgars Rinkēvičs on Friday, November 13.

latvia.title: Heating in Rīga will be costly as of December
latvia.description: The heat energy tariff charged by AS ‘Rīgas siltums’ will rise by 19 per cent from 1 December to 96.33 euros per megawatt-hour (MWh), excluding value-added tax (VAT), according to information published in the official gazette “Latvijas vēstnesis”.

latvia.title: Baltic power grids face new security reality
latvia.description: The Baltic electricity system is significantly more secure than it was five years ago. But the range of threats it must withstand has also become considerably broader – from physical attacks and sabotage to cyber threats, drones and extreme weather

latvia.title: Saturday could be a snow day in northern Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that a blanket of snow will form in some parts of Vidzeme on Saturday.

latvia.title: Science body declines to place blame in citizenship controversy
latvia.description: The Senate of the Latvian Academy of Sciences (LZA) is not aware of any evidence that the President of the Academy, Ivars Kalviņš, has knowingly violated the powers set out in the academy's statutes or acted out of personal interest by recommending granting Latvian citizenship to Indian citizen Divya Kannan Vishwanath reports the LETA newswire.

latvia.title: Another Nations League loss on the road for Latvia
latvia.description: The Latvian national team lost 2:1 away to group leaders Montenegro in the penultimate match of the UEFA Nations League on Thursday, November 12th.

latvia.description: Spotting an animal on the road sometimes means a driver has to make a decision in a matter of seconds. Experts remind us that such situations become more frequent in autumn and winter, so particular attention must be paid to driving speed and visibility, Latvian Television reports on November 13.

latvia.title: Defence industry in Latvia has expanded
latvia.description: Around 240 companies currently operate in Latvia's defence sector, and the sector’s growth is driven by rising demand for security solutions, technological developments, and more accessible financial support. Latvian companies are developing technologies such as unmanned aerial vehicles, sensors, communication systems, electronics, cyber security solutions, optics, navigation technologies and autonomous systems, Latvian Radio reported on November 13.

latvia.title: 'Iļģuciems metalhead' needs your help to make it home
latvia.description: The band ‘DJ Krankenwagen’, in collaboration with various Latvian musicians and artists, has released a video game called ‘Iļģuciems metalhead’. In it, the player takes on the role of a metal music fan and, after a concert, must make their way from the ‘Melnā piektdiena’ club back home to the Iļģuciems district in Rīga, according to the game’s creators.

latvia.title: Possible data leak issue rectified, says service provider
latvia.description: A security vulnerability has been rectified in a database containing more than 125 million text messages sent by Latvian and Lithuanian banks, insurers, retailers and service providers to their customers, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported on November 12.

latvia.description: Latvia's men's national football team are in action again on November 12th, seeking an elusive first win in the UEFA Nations League competition since March, when they narrowly overcame Gibraltar.

latvia.title: Valka municipality must take further budget-tightening measures
latvia.description: On Thursday, November 12th, the Municipal Financial Stabilization Commission reviewed the application of the Valka municipality and supported the initiation of a financial stabilization process, as well as the granting of a state budget loan of up to 190,345 euros.

latvia.title: President unconcerned by pace of government formation process
latvia.description: It may be six weeks since Latvia's parliamentary elections were held on October 3rd, but State President Edgars Rinkēvičs is not concerned that a new administration has yet to be put in place.

latvia.title: Latvia's tax service to message those who may have undeclared cash
latvia.description: In November and December, the State Revenue Service (VID) will send letters via the electronic declaration system (EDS) to residents whose cash deposits into bank accounts in 2024 may indicate undeclared income, VID said on November 12.

latvia.title: Luminor bank posts third-quarter figures
latvia.description: Baltic bank Luminor announced on November 12th its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.

latvia.description: The Latvian Journalists Association (LŽA) issued a statement on November 12th that is highly critical of Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' communication style.

latvia.title: Baltic states lead EU in homicides
latvia.description: Fresh Eurostat data show that the Baltic states have more homicides per capita than in the rest of Europe, with Latvia sitting in second place overall.

latvia.title: Parking operator hit with fine for unfair fines
latvia.description: The Consumer Rights Protection Centre (PTAC) has imposed a fine of 122,744 euros on SIA ‘Park Expert’ for unfair commercial practices in the provision of car park services, PTAC said on November 12.

latvia.title: Mobile water filter station unveiled in Rīga
latvia.description: As part of efforts to strengthen the city’s resilience in crisis situations, a mobile water filtration unit manufactured in Latvia was unveiled in Rīga on Wednesday, 11 November. If water is unavailable in the city, the unit can provide safe drinking water from any freshwater source within an hour, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.description: The effectiveness of European Union trade sanctions, Common High Priority (CHP) items and export controls, the role of crypto-assets in sanctions circumvention, sanctions enforcement, and the impact of sanctions on Russia’s economy will be the key topics of the VIII Annual sanctions conference, organised by the Financial Intelligence Unit of Latvia (FID).

latvia.title: Cabbage patch (or pile) by Rīga City Council on Thursday morning
latvia.description: On November 12 morning, farmers dumped several tonnes of vegetables grown in Latvia outside Rīga City Council, protesting against the “absurdity of the local authority’s procurement procedures for food and catering in educational institutions”.

latvia.title: Another police charity convoy heads from Latvia to Ukraine
latvia.description: On the morning of Lāčplēsis Day, the eleventh convoy for the defenders of Ukraine – jointly organised by the State Police and the “Entrepreneurs for Peace” foundation – set off from Rīga, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: Reports of major data leak involving banks and services in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the online publication ‘Cybernews’, 125 million text messages from Swedbank, SEB, the 112 emergency services helpline and dozens of retailers may have been leaked from the Latvian branch of the telecommunications service provider ‘CSCTelecom’. lithuania.description: Bocsánatot kért a francia színész.

lithuania.title: Elsüllyedt egy gabonaszállító: újabb rejtélyes támadás történt a szomszédos NATO-tagállam partjainál
lithuania.description: Tengeri dróntalálat miatt elsüllyedt egy búzát szállító teherhajó hétfőn Bulgária fekete-tengeri partjainál. A szomáliai zászló alatt közlekedő jármű tizenkét fős legénysége időben elhagyta a fedélzetet, így mindenkit épségben sikerült kimenteni.

lithuania.title: Életveszélyes csapdát állított Putyin, Európa pedig belesétál
lithuania.description: Vlagyimir Putyin az ukrajnai háború lezárását egy új európai biztonsági architektúra kérdésével kötné össze, ami első ránézésre kompromisszumnak tűnik, valójában azonban életveszélyes csapda. Moszkva ugyanis többek között Finnország NATO-ból való kilépését, a szövetség 1997 előtti állapotának visszaállítását és az ukrán hadsereg korlátozását követeli, vagyis beleszólást akar szerezni Európa biztonságába. Az ötlet Donald Trumpnak is kapóra jön, hiszen a félidős választásokon elszenvedett súlyos veresége után sikert akar felmutatni, és a felelősséget az európaiakra háríthatja. A Nyugat könnyen egy újabb München felé sodródhat, ezért a fegyverszünetről szóló tárgyalásokat el kell választani a biztonsági rendszer kérdésétől, és meg kell őrizni Ukrajna, az Egyesült Államok és Európa egységét.

lithuania.title: Minimálbér 2027: pillanatokon belül megszülethet az egyezség
lithuania.description: Kedden délután találkoznak a munkaadói, a munkavállalói, illetve a kormány képviselői, hogy megállapodjanak a 2027-es minimálbérről és a garantált bérminimumról. A munkavállalói oldal és a kormány számára megfelelő a minimálbér 7,5, illetve a garantált bérminimum 6,5%-os emelése. A vállalatok azonban ezt túl soknak tartják.

lithuania.title: Poland dismisses Russia’s claim of breaking up Polish spy network as “disinformation”
lithuania.description: Russia claims to have arrested two agents conducting espionage in Kaliningrad.

lithuania.title: Tomasz Siemoniak o zatrzymanych nastolatkach: fascynacja, która mogła prowadzić do terroru
lithuania.description: To jest nasza realność, nasza codzienność - mówił w "Kropce nad i" TVN24 minister koordynator służb specjalnych Tomasz Siemoniak, komentując zatrzymanie nastolatków, którzy mieli przygotowywać atak. Wskazał, że młodzi fascynowali się faszyzmem i Adolfem Hitlerem, a zagrożenie z ich strony było realne.

lithuania.title: Žiadne mierové jednotky, obmedzenie NATO. Prečo Moskva neustúpila ani o milimeter a čo tým sleduje?
lithuania.description: Moskve nahráva aj slabý Trump, hovorí odborník.

lithuania.title: Kushner oznámil pokrok v urovnání konfliktu na Ukrajině
lithuania.description: V otázkách bezpečnostních záruk pro Ukrajinu a jejího členství v EU dosáhla jednání pokroku směrem k výsledku, který ukončí ukrajinský konflikt a stejně tak „posílí evropskou bezpečnost a položí základy udržitelného míru“, napsal v pondělí na sociální síti X zvláštní vyslanec USA Jared Kushner. Stalo se tak po telefonátech s Kyjevem a Moskvou a zástupci šesti evropských zemí a také představiteli EU a NATO.

lithuania.title: NATO a anulat summitul din 2027 din Albania. Ce urmează pentru reuniunile liderilor Alianței
lithuania.description: NATO a anulat summitul liderilor statelor membre, planificat inițial pentru anul viitor la Tirana, capitala Albaniei, a confirmat Edi Rama, prim-ministrul albanez. Secretarul general Mark Rutte a declarat că Alianța este „flexibilă” și va organiza un summit al liderilor atunci când va fi necesar, scrie TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Dan Neculăescu, întâlnire cu şeful diplomaţiei poloneze: „România şi Polonia rămân doi piloni strategici pe Flancul Estic”
lithuania.description: Dan Neculăescu a discutat luni cu vicepremierul şi ministrul de externe al Poloniei, Radoslaw Sikorski, în marja reuniunii Consiliului Afaceri Externe, desfăşurată la Bruxelles. Ministrul Afacerilor Externe a subliniat importanţa cooperării dintre cele două state şi a coordonării pe Flancul Estic al NATO.

lithuania.title: PSD cere restructurarea instituţiilor şi companiilor de stat înainte de bugetul pe 2027: „Statul strânge cureaua, nu cetăţenii”
lithuania.description: Senatorii PSD susţin adoptarea bugetului de stat pentru anul 2027 după realizarea unei reforme administrative care să reducă cheltuielile publice şi să elimine instituţiile şi companiile de stat ineficiente sau ale căror atribuţii se suprapun. Social-democraţii afirmă că reorganizarea aparatului public trebuie să aibă loc înainte de definitivarea proiectului de buget.

lithuania.title: Peiu, după ce România nu a obținut șefia Organizaţiei Internaţionale a Francofoniei: „De ce s-a asumat un obiectiv atât de straniu?”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a criticat luni „obiectivul straniu” asumat de România de a susţine candidatura lui Dacian Cioloş pentru funcţia de secretar general al Organizaţiei Internaţionale a Francofoniei.

lithuania.title: Harta verde de la Vânătorii Mici se extinde: Pădurea DIGI crește cu încă 6.100 de puieți
lithuania.description: Vineri, 13 noiembrie, localitatea Vânătorii Mici din județul Giurgiu a găzduit, pentru al treilea an consecutiv, o nouă mobilizare a voluntarilor Grupului DIGI, dedicată regenerării unei parcele neproductive, afectate de secetă și eroziune. Reuniți sub umbrela campaniei “Pădurea DIGI. Fiecare copac, o schimbare”, 115 angajați și-au canalizat energia și eforturile pentru a îmbogăți cu peste 6.000 de puieți arealul forestier din sudul țării, alături de Asociația Act for Tomorrow, partenerul inițiativei încă de la lansare.

lithuania.title: Turos Lóránd, despre reforma administrativă propusă de PSD: „Nu poți redesena localitățile dintr-un birou din București”
lithuania.description: Reforma administrativ-teritorială propusă de PSD reprezintă „o amenințare" pentru fiecare comunitate locală din România, nu pentru UDMR, susține liderul senatorilor Uniunii, Turos Lóránd. Acesta cere ca reorganizarea să se bazeze pe date și analize tehnice și să fie realizată numai după consultarea cetățenilor și organizarea unor referendumuri în localitățile afectate.

lithuania.title: Isărescu, bilanț la aproape 20 de ani de la aderarea la UE: „A fost șansa noastră”. Cele două mari restanțe ale României
lithuania.description: România nu a reușit, în aproape două decenii de apartenență la Uniunea Europeană, să își conecteze toate regiunile prin infrastructură și să adere la zona euro, a declarat luni guvernatorul BNR, Mugur Isărescu. El a descris aderarea la UE drept un „proiect istoric" și „șansa" pe care România a valorificat-o, dar a atras atenția asupra investițiilor și reformelor rămase nefinalizate.

lithuania.title: Guvernatorul BNR respinge scenariul unui acord cu FMI: „Fondul vine când avem o criză valutară. Nu este cazul României"
lithuania.description: România nu se află în situația de a apela la un acord de finanțare cu Fondul Monetar Internațional, deoarece nu traversează o criză valutară și dispune de rezerve, a declarat luni guvernatorul BNR, Mugur Isărescu. El a precizat că țara are nevoie de finanțare, însă banii trebuie să vină din investiții străine, fonduri europene și împrumuturi de pe piețele de capital.

lithuania.title: BNR a revizuit în sus prognoza de inflație. Mugur Isărescu: „Energia și carburanții au împins estimările în creștere”
lithuania.description: Banca Națională a României a revizuit în creștere traiectoria prognozată a inflației, în principal din cauza scumpirii energiei și carburanților, a anunțat luni guvernatorul Mugur Isărescu. Rata anuală a inflației este așteptată să urce ușor până la sfârșitul anului, apoi să scadă aproape continuu și să revină în intervalul țintei în primul trimestru din 2028. Guvernatorul BNR a afirmat că prețurile de sărbători ar putea rămâne relativ stabile sau ar putea avea creșteri normale, fără scumpiri exagerate.

lithuania.title: Dezbateri aprinse pe tema comasării județelor. Dragoș Benea: „Referendumurile nu ar face altceva decât să compromită reorganizarea”
lithuania.description: Într-o intervenție telefonică la Digi24, Dragoș Benea a susținut că sunt dezbateri aprinse pe marginea reformei administrativ-teritoriale care vizează județele, explicând că, din punctul său de vedere, actualul sistem aparține anului 1968. Coordonatorul PSD pentru această reformă este de părere că eventualele referendumuri „nu ar face altceva decât să compromită această reorganizare administrativ-teritorială”.

lithuania.title: Spitalele europene nu sunt suficient de pregătite pentru crize majore. Riscurile biologice sunt pe primul loc în topul gravității
lithuania.description: Sistemele sanitare europene prezintă încă vulnerabilităţi importante în pregătirea pentru situaţii de criză majoră, inclusiv conflicte armate, atacuri asupra spitalelor şi ameninţări biologice sau chimice. Experţi ai Comisiei Europene atrag atenţia asupra noilor ameninţări la adresa sănătăţii publice şi a necesităţii consolidării rezervelor de medicamente şi echipamente medicale, în timp ce reprezentanţi ai Organizaţiei Mondiale a Sănătăţii (OMS) şi NATO subliniază importanţa pregătirii personalului şi a continuităţii îngrijirilor medicale.

lithuania.title: Susținători ai lui Călin Georgescu s-au supărat pe George Simion: „Noi, băieții din stradă, te declarăm pe tine un laș și un trădător”
lithuania.description: Revoltă printre susținătorii lui Călin Georgescu la adresa liderului AUR, George Simion. Aceștia sunt nemulțumiți că, dupăprotestul din parcul izvor, politicianul nu a venit și la protestul din fața Arestului Central, acolo unde se află fostul candidat la prezidențiale, informează Digi24. Spre seară, el a fost fotografiat la meciul de fotbal al României contra Poloniei, pe Arena Națională.

lithuania.title: Testul simplu care îți poate indica starea de sănătate: Ai nevoie de 30 de secunde și de un scaun
lithuania.description: Un test simplu, în care faci un exercițiu de așezare și ridicare pe un scaun, și care durează doar 30 de secunde, îți poate oferi informații esențiale despre starea ta de sănătate.

lithuania.title: Senatorii PSD cer ca restructurarea companiilor de stat să se facă mai repede decât a anunțat vicepremierul Neacșu
lithuania.description: Senatorii PSD susțin că reorganizarea companiilor de stat trebuie făcută înainte de adoptarea bugetului pe anul viitor, astfel încât acesta să nu fie grevat de „pietre de moară”. lithuania.title: Estonian ex-NATO envoy faults US for opening door to Russia's Europe demands
lithuania.description: Former Estonian ambassador to NATO Jüri Luik says it's troubling that the U.S. has allowed Russia to make demands about Europe's security alongside Ukraine peace talks.

lithuania.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1728. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Venemaa saab Põhja-Korealt kümneid rakette kuus
lithuania.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1728. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis. 2026/ukraina-kalender

lithuania.title: Venemaa 2. novembri rünnakus Ukraina külale hukkus 72 inimest
lithuania.description: Kuu algul Lõuna-Ukraina küla tabanud Venemaa jõhkras rünnakus on viimastel andmetel hukkunud 72 inimest, mis teeb sellest ühe ohvriterohkeima ligi viis aastat väldanud Vene-Ukraina sõjas, teatasid esmaspäeval Ukraina võimud.

lithuania.title: Possible data leak issue rectified, says service provider
lithuania.description: A security vulnerability has been rectified in a database containing more than 125 million text messages sent by Latvian and Lithuanian banks, insurers, retailers and service providers to their customers, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported on November 12.

lithuania.title: “Tas ir skaidrs nodoms!” Braže skarbi par Krievijas rīcību Ukrainā un genocīda pazīmēm
lithuania.description: Krievijai būtu izdevīgi, ja par tās rīcību Ukrainā starptautiskajā vidē runātu pēc iespējas mazāk, taču Latvijai ir pienākums turpināt šo jautājumu aktualizēt un saukt notiekošo vārdā, TV24 raidījumā “Globuss” sacīja ārlietu ministre Baiba Braže (JV). lithuania.title: Krieviju satricina lielākais Ukrainas dronu uzbrukums kopš kara sākuma: triecieni naftas rūpnīcām un Krimas tiltam
lithuania.description: Ukraina naktī uz pirmdienu, 16. novembri, īstenojusi līdz šim apjomīgāko bezpilota lidaparātu uzbrukumu Krievijas teritorijai kopš pilna mēroga kara sākuma 2022. gadā. Krievijas Aizsardzības ministrija apgalvo, ka pretgaisa aizsardzības sistēmas notriekušas 1336 Ukrainas dronus 16 valsts reģionos. lithuania.title: Krievija nemainīsies! Puče aicina Latviju jau tagad domāt par to, kas notiks pēc kara Ukrainā
lithuania.description: Krievijas sportistu iespējamā atgriešanās starptautiskajās sacensībās nav vērtējama tikai kā sporta jautājums. Krievijai sports ir arī instruments savas ideoloģijas un ietekmes izplatīšanai, tāpēc panākumi sacensībās var tikt izmantoti politiskiem mērķiem. Žurnālists un rakstnieks Armands Puče TV24 raidījumā “Nacionālo interešu klubs” pauda, ka nav pamata cerēt, ka līdz ar kara beigām Krievijas attieksme pret šo jautājumu […]

lithuania.title: “Visiem jābūt gataviem!” Kremlis slepenā sanāksmē aicina gatavoties kara beigām Ukrainā
lithuania.description: Krievijas valdošās partijas “Vienotā Krievija” pārstāvjiem slēgtā sanāksmē Valsts domē likts gatavoties kara beigām Ukrainā un masveida karadarbības dalībnieku atgriešanās brīdim. Par to, atsaucoties uz Krievijas avotiem, vēsta Ukrainas medijs “Dialog.ua”. Pasākums noticis pagājušās nedēļas nogalē. Tajā piedalījies arī Krievijas prezidenta Vladimira Putina administrācijas vadītāja vietnieks Sergejs Kirijenko. Viņš uzsvēris nepieciešamību sadarboties ar tā dēvētās […]

lithuania.title: „Reuters“: Kremlius pakeitė poziciją dėl Europos dalyvavimo taikos derybose
lithuania.description: Vladimiro Putino padėjėjas Jurijus Ušakovas pareiškė, kad Rusija nėra davusi sutikimo Europos atstovams dalyvauti derybose dėl Rusijos karo Ukrainoje užbaigimo. Jo žodžius cituoja „Reuters“.
